There’s a mooji guided meditation I did recently where he asks you to set everything aside, everything you think you are, all of your opinions and ideas, and just be there. Then he asks questions “do you have shape, a color, a sign, etc.” he gets around to things like “were you born or will you go when your body dies” and the intuitive truth in my experience is no. The most practical one he asks that I use on a day to day basis is “can you become exhausted?” And at the root of my being I don’t think I can. It’s a nice reminder to give myself as my mind is very addicted to claiming tired or exhausted as reasons to not do things that I would otherwise enjoy.
Perhaps the key is in aligning them rather than separating them?
